definitions.explanation: Abbreviation of {女子大生|じょしだいせい}, referring to female university students.

examples.japanese: JDに{人気|にんき}のバイト
examples.english: A part-time job popular among female college students.
My older sister is a college student now.

examples.japanese: JD{向|む}けのファッション{雑誌|ざっし}が{売|う}れている。
examples.english: Fashion magazines for female college students are selling well.

notes:
An internet and media abbreviation for {女子大生|じょしだいせい} (female college student). J = {女子|じょし}, D = {大生|だいせい}.

USAGE:
Common in marketing, social media, and casual conversation. Not used in formal or academic contexts.
- JD{向|む}け: targeted at female college students
- JD{人気|にんき}: popular among female college students

REGISTER:
Very informal. Appropriate in casual speech, online posts, and advertising. Avoid in formal writing or when speaking to someone you don't know well.

RELATED ABBREVIATIONS:
- JK: {女子高生|じょしこうせい} (high school girl)
- JC: {女子中学生|じょしちゅうがくせい} (middle school girl)
- {大学生|だいがくせい}: college student (gender-neutral, standard term)
